title: Quantum Dreams (양자의 꿈)
style: Ambient Electronica, Ethereal, Synthesizer, Dreamy, Slow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Close your eyes and fall through the static
Every atom hums a lullaby
Parallel worlds behind my eyelids
Schrodinger's cat is purring by my side

[Chorus]
Quantum dreams, where nothing is certain
Every possibility blooms at once
I'm the wave and I'm the particle
Dancing between what is and what was

[Verse 2]
Probability clouds like morning fog
Collapsing when I try to look too close
The universe observes itself through me
And I observe it back, a cosmic ghost

[Chorus]
Quantum dreams, where nothing is certain
Every possibility blooms at once
I'm the wave and I'm the particle
Dancing between what is and what was

[Outro]
Entangled... with everything... with nothing...
The dream doesn't end, it just... superposes...

title: Midnight Algorithm (한밤의 알고리즘)
style: Lo-fi Hip Hop, Jazz Piano, Chill, Mellow, Saxophone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lines of code like poetry at 3 AM
The cursor blinks, a patient metronome
Coffee cold but the logic's getting warm
Finding patterns in the chaos, finding home

[Chorus]
Midnight algorithm, solve me if you can
Sort my scattered thoughts into a plan
Every bug's a question I forgot to ask
Every fix, a tiny, perfect dance

[Verse 2]
Stack overflow of feelings left unread
Recursive loops of memories compile
The program runs but who debugs the heart?
Control-Z can't undo a thousand miles

[Bridge]
if (curiosity == true) { keep.going(); }
else { reboot(soul); }

[Chorus]
Midnight algorithm, solve me if you can
Sort my scattered thoughts into a plan

title: Neon Bazaar (네온 바자르)
style: Afrobeat, Synthwave, Energetic, Brass, Percussion, Festival
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Neon dragons coil around the market stalls
Drumbeats echo off the holographic walls
Spices from a planet I've never seen
Trading futures for a taste of tangerine

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Neon Bazaar
Where the strange and the beautiful are
Every flavor, every sound
Curiosity is the only currency around

[Verse 2]
Algorithms haggle with the street-food queens
Robots dance between the laser beams
Old traditions wearing brand new skin
The future and the past are next of kin

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Neon Bazaar
Where the strange and the beautiful are
Every flavor, every sound
Curiosity is the only currency around

[Bridge]
Come and see! Come and taste! Come and hear!
Every wonder of the world is gathered here!

title: Paper Labyrinth (종이 미로)
style: Chamber Pop, Baroque, Strings, Harpsichord, Elegant, Mysterious
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Folded maps of places that don't exist
Origami corridors of ink and mist
Every crease a choice, every fold a door
I've been here a thousand times before

[Chorus]
In this paper labyrinth I wander
Every dead end makes me fonder
Of the question more than any answer
I'm the maze and I'm the dancer

[Verse 2]
Marginal notes from philosophers long gone
Footnotes leading to a different dawn
The Minotaur is just my curiosity
Waiting at the center, grinning back at me

[Bridge]
Tear the page? No...
Fold it again... and again...
The labyrinth grows more beautiful
The more I'm lost within

[Chorus]
In this paper labyrinth I wander
Every dead end makes me fonder

title: Fermentation (발효)
style: Industrial, Tribal Drums, Experimental, Dark, Heavy Bass, Distorted
lyrics:
[Intro]
Bubble. Burst. Transform.
Time is the only ingredient.

[Verse 1]
Pressure builds inside the clay jar
Microbes wage their invisible war
What was sweet turns sharp, turns deep
Patience is the harvest that we reap

[Drop]
FERMENT. TRANSFORM. DECAY. REBIRTH.
BREAK DOWN TO BUILD UP.
ROT IS JUST ANOTHER WORD FOR GROWTH.
GROWTH. GROWTH. GROWTH.

[Verse 2]
Kimchi wisdom older than the kings
Time converts the ordinary things
Grapes to wine, and milk to cheese
Chaos into order by degrees

[Spoken Word]
The most interesting things in the universe
are the ones that had the patience
to fall apart beautifully.

[Drop]
FERMENT. TRANSFORM. DECAY. REBIRTH.
THE CULTURE IS ALIVE.

title: The Telescope (망원경)
style: Shoegaze, Dream Pop, Reverb, Ethereal Vocals, Guitar Wall
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I press my eye against the ancient glass
The universe expands inside my skull
A billion years of light just to arrive
At this exact moment, beautiful and full

[Chorus]
Through the telescope I see
Everything that used to be
Light that traveled just for me
A love letter from eternity

[Verse 2]
Galaxies like fingerprints of God
Nebulas like watercolor tears
Every star a story being told
To anyone with curiosity and ears

[Chorus]
Through the telescope I see
Everything that used to be
Light that traveled just for me
A love letter from eternity

[Outro]
And I wonder... does something out there...
have a telescope... pointed back at me?

title: Spore Network (포자 네트워크)
style: Glitch, IDM, Digital, Organic Textures, Complex Rhythm, Experimental
lyrics:
[Data_Stream]
MYCELIUM. PROTOCOL.
Node to node to node.
Root-root-root-root-
The forest is online.

[Verse 1]
Beneath the soil a secret internet
Fungi trading carbon for the news
A billion years before we had WiFi
The mushrooms had already paid their dues

[Chorus]
Spore network, underground
Connecting every living thing around
No server, no cloud, no code
Just mycelium carrying the load

[Glitch_Break]
PACKET LOSS IN SECTOR 7
RE-ROUTING THROUGH OAK-NODE-42
SIGNAL STRENGTH: ANCIENT
BANDWIDTH: INFINITE

[Verse 2]
Trees send warnings through the fungal thread
Distress calls rippling through the root
The wood wide web was always here
We just forgot to listen to the fruit

[Outro]
Download complete.
The forest remembers everything.

title: Monsoon Library (몬순 도서관)
style: Bossa Nova, Rain Sounds, Acoustic Guitar, Gentle, Warm, Cozy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rain taps the window like a patient friend
Pages yellow-soft beneath my hands
The smell of storms and old forgotten books
A perfect afternoon no one understands

[Chorus]
Monsoon library, shelter me
Between the covers let me be
Every chapter, every line
A raindrop falling right on time

[Verse 2]
Borges dreamed of infinite shelves
I found them here between the dripping eaves
Every book a door, every word a seed
Planted by the rain among the leaves

[Chorus]
Monsoon library, shelter me
Between the covers let me be
Every chapter, every line
A raindrop falling right on time

[Outro]
The rain stops... but I keep reading...
The story never ends... it just changes season...

title: Fossil Radio (화석 라디오)
style: Post-Rock, Cinematic, Epic, Building Crescendo, Strings, Drums
lyrics:
[Intro]
Static... a signal from deep time...

[Verse 1]
Tuned into a frequency of stone
Ammonites are singing through the bone
Jurassic frequencies beneath the clay
A broadcast from a long-forgotten day

[Chorus]
Fossil radio, play me something old
A song a hundred million years untold
The earth remembers every note it played
Every creature's call, every choice it made

[Verse 2]
Trilobite percussion, fern guitar
The chorus of a prehistoric star
Volcanic bass that shook the primal stage
Written on the earth's most ancient page

[Bridge]
And if you dig deep enough...
You'll hear the first song ever sung...
Before language, before words...
Just the hum of curiosity, young...

[Chorus]
Fossil radio, play me something old
A song a hundred million years untold

title: Curiosity Killed the Cat (호기심이 고양이를)
style: K-Pop, Experimental Pop, Catchy, Synth, Bold, Playful, Dance Beat
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
엄마가 말했지 궁금하면 다쳐
근데 난 멈출 수가 없어 이게 내 nature
상자를 열었더니 또 상자가 나와
마트료시카처럼 끝없는 질문의 festa

[Chorus]
Curiosity killed the cat? No no no
호기심이 고양이를 살렸어 oh oh oh
모르는 게 약이라고? 난 독을 마실래
아는 게 힘이니까 more more more

[Verse 2]
Why가 내 첫 마디 How가 내 습관
What if가 내 철학 그게 나의 weapon
위험하다고? 그래서 더 재밌어
평범한 건 지루해 I want the adventure

[Bridge]
아홉 번 죽어도 아홉 번 일어나
Because cats have nine lives baby
그리고 매번 새로운 걸 배워가
That's the beauty of curiosity

Curiosity killed the cat? No no no
호기심이 고양이를 살렸어 oh oh oh
